name: Terraform Plan Only
description: Validate and plan Terraform changes without applying or destroying infrastructure.

config_path.description: Relative path to the Terraform configuration directory

steps.description: Validate the Terraform configuration for syntax and internal consistency
Generate a Terraform execution plan without applying changes

constraints: Only Terraform validate and plan are allowed in this recipe
The Terraform configuration path stays inside the caller-approved workspace scope
This recipe never produces an apply-ready plan artifact or mutation command
invariants: No terraform apply, destroy, import, or state mutation command is present
Every step runs in structured mode with deterministic terraform argv
Approval covers the exact relative Terraform configuration path
